item.title: Tucker Carlson Amazed At How Clean And Well-Run The Murdering Of Iranian Protestors Is
item.description: U.S. — After watching the news of the Iranian government executing tens of thousands of protestors, political commentator Tucker Carlson expressed amazement at how clean and well-run the murders were.

item.title: Ominous Sign? New Army Recruitment Ads Say 'Visit Lovely Greenland'
item.description: U.S. — In yet another potentially ominous sign that President Donald Trump was dead-set on the United States acquiring the territory for strategic and national security purposes, new U.S. Army recruitment ads offered prospective enlistees the opportunity to "Visit Lovely Greenland."

item.title: Progressive Researchers Claim They Are 15-20 Years From Finding Out What A Woman Is
item.description: U.S. — Progressive researchers working with the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU ) said they were only a mere 15-20 years away from finding out what a woman is.

item.title: NATO Begs U.S. For Emergency Funding So They Can Defend Greenland From U.S.
item.description: BRUSSELS — Amid the looming threat of a U.S. military takeover of Greenland, NATO requested emergency aid from the U.S. to help it defend Greenland from the U.S.

item.title: Listen Up, Ladies! Here Are 8 Beauty Tips To Help You Attract A Hunky Conservative Dude
item.description: Every woman wants a hunky, conservative dude to marry. The hard part is knowing how to attract them.

item.title: New Starfleet Vessel Unable To Reach Warp Speed Because Crew Is Too Fat
item.description: SPACE, THE FINAL FRONTIER — The exploration of other strange, new worlds and the seeking out of new life and new civilizations hit an unexpected snag this week, as Starfleet's newest vessel was reportedly unable to reach warp speed because the crew was too fat.
